references.text: The Israelites were to camp each by their own banner and by their own division, according to their armies.
A detailed description of how the tribes were to camp around the tabernacle under their banners.
Describes how the tribes set out under their banners in the order that was established.
God's command to build a sanctuary so He could dwell among His people, which is the center of the camp arrangement.
Moses pitched the tent of meeting outside the camp, a precursor to the central placement of the tabernacle.
Ezekiel's vision of the tribes' placement around the new city, reflecting the camp arrangement in the wilderness.
The new Jerusalem with twelve gates named after the twelve tribes of Israel, reflecting the ordered structure around God's dwelling.
